'''February 1999 Bisley tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 28 February 1999 at Bisley. [[Rod Latham]] finished 9th of 22.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst9">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst9.htm Ralltiir Kessel Run], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228074212/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst9.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst6">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst6.htm Pacific Blue 17], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228073514/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst6.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 28 February 1999
* '''Site:''' Bisley
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

Both decks are dated 28 February (the index gives February 1999). Their records add up to 3–3, matching this event on Latham's results page.
